protocol.title: Frozen fine-grained Memory pathway causal intervention
protocol.freeze_rule: requires_grad=False for the selected group only; AdamW state, RNG, data stream and update gate remain exact and active
protocol.stop_rule: No additional groups, layers, seeds, steps or post-hoc gates

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, or post-hoc gates.
diagnosis.classification_note: Tie-safe classification: equal material effects across all registered L2/L3 groups are reported as distributed_fine_memory.
